'''Reserve''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. ==Dialogue== {{quote|Look who we've got here! Hello there! Listen, you know about the military base close to the health resort? Probably were there yourself. So, I've got some news. They say the old warehouses there still have a lot of food left in them, and that bandit groups began roaming there, not your regular Scavs, they are well-equipped. I want you to check out if there's anything left in those warehouses. But be careful, there really are a lot of dangerous people there.}} ==Objectives== * Locate the food storage location on [[Reserve]] * Survive and extract from the location ==Rewards== * +28,000 [[EXP]] * [[Jaeger]] Rep '''+0.75''' * 275,000 Roubles ** 288,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 316,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 {{quote|Have they already started to take everything out?
